subject: Television & Streaming
title: Silence as Dialogue
description: A quick, practical guide to Silence as Dialogue.

hook.text: In Better Call Saul, entire scenes play out in silence. Characters stare, wait, and breathe. The tension is unbearable.

discovery.text: But silence communicates what words can't.

twist.text: The most powerful scene in Breaking Bad's 'Ozymandias' is Walter White's silent face as his world collapses.

climax.text: Great TV writing knows when to shut up. Silence is a tool as precise as any line of dialogue when used deliberately.

punchline.text: The best line in television is sometimes no line at all.

quiz.question: Why is silence considered a powerful writing tool in television?
options: A character choosing not to speak can reveal as much as dialogue, communicating what words cannot
